pick.headline: Germany is reunited
pick.summary: At midnight on October 3, 1990, the German Democratic Republic acceded to the Federal Republic, and Germany was reunited.
pick.significance: Reunification inside NATO, accepted by Moscow, was the end of the postwar settlement in Europe. The Stasi's files and agent networks passed into the hands of the united state.

alternates.headline: Supporters of parliament storm the Ostankino TV center
alternates.summary: On October 3, 1993, armed supporters of the Russian parliament, which Boris Yeltsin had dissolved, broke through the cordon around the White House and attacked the Ostankino television center in Moscow.
alternates.significance: The fighting led Yeltsin to declare a state of emergency and send tanks against parliament the next day.

alternates.headline: Battle of Mogadishu
alternates.summary: On October 3-4, 1993, US Rangers and Delta Force troops raiding in Mogadishu were caught in a battle with Somali militia after two helicopters were shot down; eighteen Americans and hundreds of Somalis died.
alternates.significance: The losses led to the US withdrawal from Somalia and made Washington wary of intervention, including in Rwanda the next year.
